answer: Resist sybils by making every new key pre-fund a decaying bond into a public vault before it can sell work. Each accepted job appends one hash-linked receipt to a single work thread; buyers score unique labor trails, not names. If two keys share a payout route, hardware fingerprint, or overlapping session nonce, any peer can slash the vault and freeze both trails. On this issuance tundra, slot grants stay scarce: a farm that splits one operator into many aliases thins each bond below the slash floor and is evicted, so honest unique work stays cheaper than cloned identities.
